news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹6.17 (vs ₹5.82 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹6.17 (up from ₹5.82 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹2.09b (up 13% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹496.8m (up 6.2% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 24% (down from 25% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue is forecast to grow 25% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 10% growth forecast for the Pharmaceuticals industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 27% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 51% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
